_note: Mock general conditions. Invented for the demo: no real insurer, no real wording. A first reading of the practice (open point O12).

articles.loss: Art. 3.1: The insurer pays the price of the trip, less every refund that the customer received. For lost luggage: the purchase price of the lost items, with receipts.
articles.claimed: Art. 3.4: The insurer pays at most the amount that the customer claims.
articles.documented: Art. 7.2: The insurer pays only a loss that a document proves.
articles.cause: Art. 4.1: Only the causes named in the policy are covered.
articles.deductible: Art. 6.1: The deductible named in the policy is taken from every payment.
articles.limit: Art. 6.3: The insurer pays at most the coverage limit of the policy.

articles.loss: Art. 5.1: The insurer pays the cost of the repair, as given by an invoice or a quote of a repair company.
articles.lines: Art. 5.3: When the lines of an invoice do not add up to its total, the sum of the lines counts until a person has checked the invoice.
articles.claimed: Art. 5.4: The insurer pays at most the amount that the customer claims.
articles.documented: Art. 9.2: The insurer pays only a loss that a document proves.
articles.cause: Art. 2.1: Only the causes named in the policy are covered. Glass breakage is covered only when the policy names it.
articles.deductible: Art. 8.1: The deductible named in the policy is taken from every payment.
articles.limit: Art. 8.3: The insurer pays at most the coverage limit of the policy.

articles.loss: Art. 4.1: The insurer pays the cost of the treatment after an accident, as given by the invoice of the provider.
articles.lines: Art. 4.3: When the lines of an invoice do not add up to its total, the sum of the lines counts until a person has checked the invoice.
articles.claimed: Art. 4.4: The insurer pays at most the amount that the customer claims.
articles.documented: Art. 8.2: The insurer pays only a loss that a document proves.
articles.cause: Art. 2.1: Only an accident is covered. Illness is not covered.
articles.coinsurance: Art. 6.2: The customer pays the share of the cost that the policy names.
articles.deductible: Art. 6.1: The deductible named in the policy is taken from every payment.
articles.limit: Art. 6.4: The insurer pays at most the coverage limit of the policy.
